Owner only. A 256-bit invitation binds to the first accepting authenticated recipient. 15 minutes through 7 days. Control enables only text send/queue, cancel, and typed request replies. Accepted work is not recalled on expiry. Idempotency is scoped to owner and the sharing API; plaintext invite is not stored.

UserBearer.description: Opaque user token from wx.login exchange; never put in URL.

NodeBearer.description: Short-lived token obtained by Ed25519 proof, only valid for Node control WSS.

EnrollmentPoll.description: One-enrollment polling secret; cannot access client resources.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client operation ID, 16–128 ASCII letters/digits/_/-. Scoped to user; same key and same canonical request return original receipt, changed body is 409.

PageToken.name: pageToken
PageToken.description: Opaque signed owner/filter-bound keyset cursor; not an event cursor.

x-websockets.description: One app-level socket. watch acknowledgement pins metadata/session barriers; then HTTP catch-up and drain buffered live frames.
One outbound Node socket; new epoch fences old connection. Only committed source events are acknowledged.
